bridge-vernal-fall-footbridge.summary: Footbridge over the Merced at the top of the first climb from Happy Isles, with the classic view of Vernal Fall.
bridge-vernal-fall-footbridge.notice: NPS, October 2, 2026: Mist Trail work above the footbridge means a Monday to Thursday, 7 am to 3:30 pm detour through October, subject to change. Nothing in that notice closes the footbridge itself. Check current trail conditions.

bridge-swinging-bridge.summary: Footbridge over the Merced beside the Swinging Bridge picnic area, looking up at Yosemite Falls.
bridge-swinging-bridge.accessibility: NPS describes paved, mostly level approaches to the bridge. The picnic ground is unpaved and the beach is not wheelchair accessible.

bridge-sentinel-bridge.summary: A Merced River crossing with the well-known view of Half Dome and its reflection, best around sunset.
bridge-sentinel-bridge.accessibility: NPS describes marked accessible parking nearby and a paved sidewalk onto the bridge.

bridge-el-capitan-bridge.summary: The Merced crossing on El Capitan Drive next to El Capitan Meadow.
bridge-el-capitan-bridge.notice: NPS, October 2, 2026: the trail across El Capitan Bridge is closed on weekdays through December for bridge work, and drivers should expect 15-minute delays Monday to Friday, 7 am to 7 pm, with short closures and a detour possible. Check current conditions before relying on this crossing.

ev-yosemite-falls.summary: In the north-east corner of the Yosemite Falls day-use lot; NPS counts ten Level 2 chargers.

ev-ahwahnee.summary: At the south-west end of The Ahwahnee's parking; NPS counts six Level 2 chargers. You do not need to be a hotel guest, but move the car once it has charged.

ev-valley-lodge-laurel.summary: Four chargers between the Laurel and Juniper buildings. Another four stand in front of Alder opposite the front desk, without a confirmed pin, making eight at the Lodge.

details.label: Chargers at this pin
details.text: 4 J1772 ports, Level 2 AC. This is the installed count, not how many are free.

details.label: The other Lodge bank
details.text: Four more chargers face Alder, across from the front desk. Follow the signs; the Maple-versus-Alder labelling on the map has not been resolved, and the count on this pin covers Laurel and Juniper only.

details.label: Network
details.text: Rivian Waypoints, per the AFDC station record.

details.label: Rated power
details.text: AFDC lists up to 11 kW per port. What your car draws depends on the vehicle and the site.

details.label: Who runs it
details.text: Installed under the Rivian and Adopt a Charger program for Yosemite and managed by Yosemite Hospitality according to NPS. The electrical contractor is not recorded.

details.label: Before you plug in
details.text: Carry the J1772 adapter your car needs, read the posted price and idle-fee rules instead of assuming charging is free, and expect no live status: this guide has no occupancy feed.

ev-curry-village.summary: In the west lot east of Stoneman Bridge; NPS counts twenty Level 2 chargers.

ev-welcome-center.summary: In the lot east of the Valley Welcome Center; NPS counts four Level 2 chargers.

ev-wawona-store.summary: In the lot beside the Wawona Store, near the Yosemite History Center; NPS counts 24 Level 2 chargers.
ev-wawona-store.sourceNote: NPS public GIS feature 21097 and AFDC station 391166, reviewed October 2, 2026. The pin is an orientation point, not a field observation.

ev-el-portal-market.summary: Two Level 2 chargers next to the El Portal Market and gas station, outside the park entrance.
ev-el-portal-market.notice: The pin uses AFDC station coordinates, not surveyed bay positions. Follow the signs; whether the equipment works or a bay is free is not known to this guide.
ev-el-portal-market.sourceNote: AFDC station 391217, confirmed and updated October 2, 2026 (04:15 UTC), retrieved the same day; geocode status GPS.

ev-tuolumne-meadows.summary: Four Level 2 chargers near the Tuolumne Meadows store on the site of the old gas station. The road in is seasonal; check Tioga Road first.
ev-tuolumne-meadows.sourceNote: NPS public GIS feature 22864 and AFDC station 391103, reviewed October 2, 2026. The pin is an orientation point, not a field observation.

ev-redwoods-wawona.summary: Two Level 2 chargers at The Redwoods central office, 8038 Chilnualna Falls Road.
ev-redwoods-wawona.notice: The pin uses AFDC station coordinates, not surveyed bay positions. Follow the signs; whether the equipment works or a bay is free is not known to this guide.
ev-redwoods-wawona.sourceNote: AFDC station 220767, confirmed and updated October 2, 2026 (02:13 UTC), retrieved the same day; geocode status GPS.

details.label: Chargers at this pin
details.text: 2 J1772 ports, Level 2 AC. This is the installed count, not how many are free.

details.label: Network
details.text: ChargePoint, per the AFDC station record.

details.label: Rated power
details.text: AFDC lists up to 6.5 kW per port. What your car draws depends on the vehicle and the site.

details.label: Who runs it
details.text: Hosted at The Redwoods central office on the ChargePoint network; the installer is not recorded.

details.label: Before you plug in
details.text: Carry the J1772 adapter your car needs, read the posted price and idle-fee rules instead of assuming charging is free, and expect no live status: this guide has no occupancy feed.

dump-upper-pines.summary: RV waste disposal just inside the Upper Pines entrance. NPS lists it as open all year with fresh water; Recreation.gov lists use as free.
dump-upper-pines.notice: Follow the signs to the relocated station. The pin is approximate and today's operation has not been checked.
dump-upper-pines.sourceNote: Reviewed October 2, 2026. Season and water come from NPS guidance, the free-use note from Recreation.gov. Position: © OpenStreetMap contributors, node 3424485565 version 8 (September 18, 2025), ODbL. NPS GIS still shows the earlier riverside spot.

details.label: Where the pin comes from
details.text: A community-mapped position for the moved station: an October 2024 edit recorded a locally verified move and the point was nudged in September 2025. The exact drain and entrance are still unconfirmed.

details.label: Fresh water
details.text: NPS lists fresh water at the station. Fill drinking tanks only from the outlet signed for potable water, never with a rinse hose.

details.label: Who may use it
details.text: Whether visitors without a campsite can use the station is unconfirmed. Follow campground signs and ask staff before entering restricted loops.

dump-wawona.summary: A summer-only RV dump station on Forest Drive east of the Wawona Store. NPS lists fresh water at its dump stations.
dump-wawona.notice: Summer only; do not expect it to be open in October. Today's operation has not been checked.
dump-wawona.sourceNote: Reviewed October 2, 2026. NPS public GIS feature 22323, edited January 10, 2026, with unknown source date and accuracy. The published season is not a live status.

details.label: Where the pin comes from
details.text: An NPS digitized point of unknown accuracy. This is the Wawona dump station, separate from the campground pin.

details.label: Before using it
details.text: Confirm the season, hours, fees and whether non-campers may use it. Follow the signs for potable water versus rinse outlets.

dump-tuolumne-meadows.summary: The RV dump station near Tuolumne Meadows is closed until further notice for wastewater-plant work. Do not plan around it.
dump-tuolumne-meadows.notice: Closed until further notice. This pin records a location, not a working station.
dump-tuolumne-meadows.sourceNote: Reviewed October 2, 2026. NPS public GIS feature 20409, edited January 10, 2026, with unknown source date and accuracy. The closure comes from NPS campground guidance, not a live feed.

details.label: Closure
details.text: NPS reports an ongoing closure for work on the wastewater treatment plant. The normal season is summer only; reopening and water availability are unknown.

details.label: Where the pin comes from
details.text: An NPS digitized point of unknown accuracy, recording the facility rather than an available service.

details.label: Road access
details.text: Tioga Road is seasonal; check its status before heading to the high country.
